author: Inside Edition
description: Two school principals were pulled over on suspicion of drunk driving. Christina Alcalde and Jennifer Jimenez also produce motivational videos at Pinecrest Academy in Clermont, Florida. Police say Jimenez was behind the wheel of Alcalde's car, allegedly intoxicated, with Alcalde in the passenger seat. Alcalde, who, authorities say, left the traffic stop in a rideshare car, was arrested two and a half hours later, by the same officer, driving Jimenez’s vehicle. Both women have pleaded not guilty to DUI charges.
title: 2 School Principals Arrested Hours Apart For DUI

author: Inside Edition
description: High school student Lilli Jankowski flew across the country in hopes of finding a spectacular weather event to make her senior photos look amazing. Extraordinary images show her posing with an epic duct storm looming in the background. Jankowski, 17, tells Inside Edition she dreams of becoming a meteorologist. She flew from Reading, Pennsylvania to Phoenix, Arizona where she met up with professional photographer and storm chaser Mike Olbinski.
title: Aspiring Meteorologist Takes High School Graduation Photos With Epic Dust Storm

author: Inside Edition
description: A Georgia woman died after being run over by a truck driven by her estranged husband and the moment was caught on her own home surveillance video. The family of Janice Frazier says the disturbing video leaves them with many unanswered questions. Frazier's family says the couple were going through a divorce and were living separately, but they don't know why her husband showed up that night. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Man Not Charged After Car He Drove Ran Over Estranged Wife, Causing Her Death

author: Inside Edition
description: A history lover with deep pockets is now the proud owner of Gus. That's the name given to a T. rex fossil and from what experts say, it's the closest anyone can come to owning an entire dinosaur. The fossil, found in 2021, is more than 60% complete, with a well-preserved skull. To find that much of the same fossil after 67 million years is quite impressive. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Gus, A T. Rex Fossil, Sells For Record-Setting $50M
